result.title: Thundertree 9 · Herbalist’s shop
result.tv: Show only this location and creatures the characters have discovered. Keep other buildings fogged.
read: Broken bottles and unreadable books fill an old shop.

Glass fragments and damaged pages share the floor beneath the shelving. You can examine one storage place at a time rather than overturn the whole room. If someone has given you a description to follow, you can compare it with what you actually see here.
ask: How do you approach, and where is each character?
run: If Mirna Dendrar sent them, the heirloom case is found automatically. Otherwise DC 15 Perception finds it behind the shelves.
Inside is her emerald necklace worth 200 gp. Record whether the party returns it; doing so earns the printed reward if using XP.
private: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), printed pp. 30–35; use its private marked map for exact building positions.
